Class NewsBeanSearchTag

java.lang.Object
javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.TagSupport
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.view.general.ModelBeanSearchTag
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.view.news.NewsBeanSearchTag
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.IterationTag, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.JspTag, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag
public class NewsBeanSearchTag extends ModelBeanSearchTag
NewsBeanSearchTag.java This class implements a JSP Tag whose main objective is to take a Collection of NewsItemBean and display them in a table using some supplied parameters.
